instruction.text: Complete the sentence with an appropriate subordinating conjunction.

atoms.b: ((++Although Because If)) Seren enjoys watching football on the TV, she does not enjoy playing it.
((++If That Because)) you finish your homework, you can go to the park.
Dani didn’t go to school ((++because although that)) they felt unwell.
We will go to the park ((++when that because)) it stops raining.
((++If Although That)) Ray studies, he will do well in his exams.
((++Although When If)) she doesn’t like peas, Deli ate them.
I am going to the shop ((++because although that)) I need tomatoes.
I believe ((++that although when)) I am free on Wednesday.
